LanguageData.FilterSignals_CanMake: Able to be produced in this colony
LanguageData.FilterSignals_UnableToMake: This colony is unable to make it.
LanguageData.FilterSignals_ToggleTooltip: Click to show or hide this classification in this dialog only. Your allowed-item configuration is never changed.
LanguageData.FilterSignals_Settings_Feature_Tooltip: Adds transient production classifications to vanilla ThingFilter dialogs. Disabling this leaves every stored ThingFilter unchanged.
LanguageData.FilterSignals_Settings_Toolbar_Tooltip: Shows four temporary classification toggles above vanilla item filters. Hidden by default because the colored status squares remain available. These toggles never change allowed items.
LanguageData.FilterSignals_Settings_Indicators_Toolti: Draws a compact colored indicator beside each visible item. Hover it for the production-path explanation.
LanguageData.FilterSignals_Settings_Materials_Tooltip: When enabled, a technologically available recipe is shown as unavailable if none of an ingredient's allowed materials are present. Disabled by default because inventory changes are temporary.
